title: Scalable Multigrid Solver for the Helmholtz Equation: Real-Shifted Coarse Grid Correction
summary: We present a convergent and scalable multigrid solver for high-frequency Helmholtz equations. Standard multigrid methods do not converge for high-frequency Helmholtz problems, and a common cure is adding a complex shift and using the shifted operator as a preconditioner. Nevertheless, the complex shift prevents scalability. In this work we present a new method that achieves scalable convergence of a 3-level cycle without a complex shift.
